text.p: Renaissance Solutions Inc said Wednesday it has established two strategic business units to consolidate its recent acquisitions.

The company said it has created the Renaissance Strategic Services Group, combining the Firm's Balanced Scorecard practice with the recently acquired COBA Consulting Ltd and C.M. Management Systems Ltd. This group will be headed by David Norton, President and CEO of Renaissance.

It has also formed the Performance Solutions Group, which is comprised of Renaissance's performance innovation practice and the recently acquired International Systems Solutions Corp. Bruce Gupton, former President and CEO of ISS, has assumed the position of Executive Vice President of Renaissance, president of this newly formed group, and a director of Renaissance.
Renaissance also said Wednesday that Gresham Brebach has resigned as executive vice president to form a new company, ETC.
